comparison.objective: Pack selected boxes into a carton according to a printed two-layer plan while excluding distractors.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan interpretation, layered placement, and contact pushing to meet tight face-position tolerances.
comparison.success_condition: Four specified boxes match planned faces within 5 mm and two excluded boxes remain outside the carton.
comparison.reason: This is constrained packing and visual-plan execution, with no adjustable mechanism or response-based calibration.
